rationale: The interpreter introduced an unsupported assumption by stating that the 3/8‑inch tube with 1‑inch spacing increment is "instead of the generic increment", which is not mentioned in the ticket. This adds a non‑specified policy that could mislead implementation. No other issues were found and there are no unresolved ambiguities.

findings.description: The interpreter adds a statement that the 3/8‑inch tube with 1‑inch spacing increment is "instead of the generic increment", which is not present in the ticket.
findings.action: Remove the unsupported reference to a generic increment and the notion of an override.

sourceRefs.quote: The 3/8-inch tube with 1-inch spacing increment is 1.00 inch instead of the generic increment.
